Usage: s_client [options] [host[:port]]

Valid options are:
 -help                Display this summary
 -host val            The -connect option or the -proxy option
 -port val            The -connect option or the -proxy option
 -4                   Use IPv4 only
 -6                   Use IPv6 only
 -cipher val          TLS cipher list to offer
 -verify int          Turn on peer certificate verification
 -verify_return_error Return verification errors
 -msg                 Show all protocol messages with hex dump
 -nbio                Run with non-blocking IO
 -brief               Only print a summary of the connection
